verify_email.subject: Confirm your e-mail for TerraReality
verify_email.text:
Hello{{if .Name}} {{.Name}}{{end}},

please confirm your e-mail address by opening this link:
{{.Link}}

The link is valid for 48 hours. If you did not create an account, ignore this message.

magic_link.subject: Sign in to TerraReality
magic_link.text:
Hello,

open this link to sign in:
{{.Link}}

The link is valid for 15 minutes and works once. If you did not ask to sign in, ignore this message.

password_reset.subject: Reset your TerraReality password
password_reset.text:
Hello,

set a new password here:
{{.Link}}

The link is valid for 1 hour. Changing the password signs you out on all devices. If you did not ask for this, ignore this message.

invitation.subject: Invitation to {{.OrgName}}
invitation.text:
Hello,

{{.InviterName}} invites you to join {{.OrgName}} on TerraReality (role: {{.Role}}).

Accept the invitation here:
{{.Link}}

The invitation is valid for 7 days.

export_ready.subject: Your data export is ready
export_ready.text:
Hello,

the export of your personal data is ready in your privacy settings:
{{.Link}}

The download link is short-lived; it is generated when you download.

erasure_scheduled.subject: Account erasure request received
erasure_scheduled.text:
Hello,

your account will be erased on {{.Date}}. Until then you can cancel the request in your privacy settings:
{{.Link}}

Contract documents are retained for the period required by law.

erasure_rejected.subject: Account erasure could not be completed

sms_code.subject: SMS
sms_code.text: TerraReality: your verification code is {{.Code}}. Valid for 10 minutes.

listing_approved.subject: Listing approved: {{.Title}}

listing_rejected.subject: Listing returned for changes: {{.Title}}

saved_search_digest.subject: New listings for "{{.Name}}" ({{.Count}})

new_message.subject: New message from {{.Sender}}: {{.Listing}}
new_message.text:
Hello,

{{.Sender}} wrote to you about “{{.Listing}}”:

“{{.Preview}}”

Reply here:
{{.Link}}

TerraReality never asks for payment before a viewing. If someone asks you to pay in advance, report the conversation.

Notification settings: {{.Settings}}

messages_digest.subject: Unread messages ({{.Count}})

moderation_warning.subject: A warning about your conversation

messaging_suspended.subject: Messaging suspended

group_invitation.subject: {{.Inviter}} invites you to the group “{{.Group}}”
group_invitation.text:
Hello,

{{.Inviter}} invites you to the group “{{.Group}}” on TerraReality, so you can look for a home together and apply as one.

Accept the invitation here:
{{.Link}}

application_consent.subject: Confirm the group application: {{.Listing}}
application_consent.text:
Hello,

{{.Applicant}} prepared an application for “{{.Listing}}” on behalf of your group. The landlord sees it once every member confirms it.

Review and confirm it here:
{{.Link}}

application_received.subject: New rental application: {{.Listing}}
application_received.text:
Hello,

a new application arrived for “{{.Listing}}” (household of {{.Household}}).

Applicants:
{{.Link}}

application_invited.subject: Invitation to a viewing: {{.Listing}}

application_accepted.subject: The landlord chose your application: {{.Listing}}
application_accepted.text:
Hello,

congratulations, the landlord chose your application for “{{.Listing}}”. The next step is the lease; they will contact you through TerraReality.

{{.Link}}

Do not send any money before signing the lease.

application_rejected.subject: Answer to your application: {{.Listing}}
application_rejected.text:
Hello,

thank you for your interest in “{{.Listing}}”. The landlord decided not to accept the application ({{.ReasonText}}).

Find more homes on TerraReality.
{{.Link}}

viewing_booked.subject: Viewing booked: {{.Listing}}, {{.When}}
viewing_booked.text:
Hello,

an applicant booked a viewing of “{{.Listing}}” on {{.When}}.

Applicants and viewings:
{{.Link}}

viewing_reminder.subject: Viewing reminder: {{.Listing}}, {{.When}}
